question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The treaty was signed by both the parties to retain the __status-quo__.
solution:
The correct answer is "**current situation**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The phrase "retain the status-quo" means to maintain the current situation or state of affairs.**
 
• Status quo is a Latin phrase meaning the existing state of affairs.(यथास्थिति)
 
 
• Particularly with regard to social, political, religious, scientific or military issues.
 
• Example: She wants to maintain the status quo. 
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the treaty was signed by both the parties to maintain the current state of affairs.
 
• Thus, it can be concluded that option 3 explains the meaning of the underlined phrase.

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, "previous condition," refers to a situation that existed before the present one.(पिछली स्थिति)
 
• Option 2, "unnatural behaviour," refers to behavior that is not typical or normal.(अप्राकृतिक व्यवहार)
 
• Option 4, "class of societies," refers to a group of societies with similar characteristics or traits.(समाजों का वर्ग)
